text:
nina: Opened a PR to tidy the onboarding quickstart for the hello app: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/518. Changes: update Python/TS auth snippets to SDK7, fix docker port, remove stale KMS link, add tiny SDK6->7 pointer, and note required token scope.

carlos: thanks — which KMS link is stale?

nina: it pointed to /docs/kms-old. should be /docs/integrations/kms after the docs reorg.

dom: CI flagged a snippet test failure. Looks like the python sample still used RW_API_KEY.

mei: yep our snippet-tests expect REDWOOD_API_KEY now. failing assert: expected import from redwood.api.RedwoodClient.

nina: failing snippet here:

nina: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("RW_API_KEY"))
```

sam: update to SDK7 style and env var:

sam: ```python
from redwood.api import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```

carlos: also please change the docker example — quickstart used `docker run -p 8081:8080` which is wrong for the starter. make it `-p 8080:8080` and reference starter commit def456.

mei: add a one-line migration pointer: "Migrating from SDK6? See /docs/migration/sdk6-to-7". keep it short.

nina: added a short note about token scopes: "Ensure your key has inference:generate scope to run quickstart examples." saves support tickets.

ci-bot: ci/build-docs #518 \u2014 snippet-check failed: QuickstartTests.test_python_auth_line. Log: https://ci.internal/builds/518/log

nina: pushed fixes to PR: swapped env var, updated import, corrected docker command, fixed KMS link, added migration pointer and token scope line. bumping CI.

ci-bot: ci/build-docs #518 \u2014 rerun: now passing \u2705 (https://ci.internal/builds/518/log)

dom: product asked for two small clarifications: (1) mention hosted free credits in "first deploy" and link to pricing, (2) add a one-sentence caveat about Dedicated rollbacks and where to find rollout docs.

carlos: doing a quick copyedit pass and will add the product nits inline.

mei: i opened a small redirect PR for the old KMS path so existing links don't 404: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/519

nina: perfect. i'll merge once redirects are live and staging looks good. i'll follow up with a minimal TypeScript auth example in a second small PR so this one stays focused. thanks all :white_check_mark:
